description: Starter crosswalk for OWASP AISVS 1.0. This file is NOT the full 191-requirement catalogue; it seeds machine-readable control evaluation (R-007).

requirements.title: AI system scope and threat model documented
evidence_expectations: SOURCE_STATIC policy or architecture doc citing scope and threats
requirements.test_method: Review documented scope/threat model; mark NOT_VERIFIED if absent
requirements.limitation: Starter mapping only; full AISVS chapter coverage not included

requirements.title: Untrusted input boundaries for agent instructions
requirements.test_method: Map untrusted sources to agent actions; require explicit unknowns
requirements.limitation: Does not prove runtime containment without authorized staging

requirements.title: Tool and plugin authorization
requirements.test_method: Verify least-privilege and server identity binding in static/host evidence
requirements.limitation: Authorization enforcement at runtime is NOT_VERIFIED in passive mode

crosswalk_notes: Threat taxonomies (e.g. OWASP Agentic Top 10) are mapped separately from verification requirements.
No control in this pack may be marked PASS from narrative assertion alone.
